## 5. Means of redress.

Tenderers may submit any observations concerning the procurement procedure to the contracting authority using the contact details under Heading I.1 of the contract notice. If tenderers believe that there is maladministration, they may lodge a complaint to the European Ombudsman within two years of the date from which they become aware of the facts which form the basis for the complaint (see https:L/www ombudsman europa eu).

Within two months of notification of the outcome of the procedure (award decision) , tenderers launch an action for its annulment. request tenderers may make and any reply from the contracting authority, or any complaint for maladministration, will have neither the purpose nor the effect of suspending the time-limit for launching an action for annulment nor open a new period for launching an action for annulment. The body responsible for hearing annulment procedures is indicated under Heading VI.4.1 of the contract notice. may Any

Yours faithfully , Juhan Lepassaar, Executive Director (e-signed)
